services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Tandem skydiving or tandem parachuting is a type of skydiving there will be a instructor attached to you and no need to worry when you go for tandem skydiving .The best place to Jump is FLORIDA SKYDIVING. If you want to try skydive your age should be at least 18years and you must be 230lb maximum weight. where an expert will be there to train you one hour ground training will be there tandem master will train you through the jump and experience yourself during free fall, and you can view the scenery during free fall… and guides you to easy landing on the flexible belly of a beached whale. Wear comfortable, weather appropriate clothing and tennis shoes for best experience, which you can wear
